finalText:
Build's green now — exit code 0, "0 errors."

The wall of `WARN DEP0*` and dedupe/tree-shaking lines was all cosmetic noise from the bumped bundler; those aren't errors and don't need fixing. The actual blocker was two real regressions introduced by the bump, both at the link stage in `src/`:

- **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`; the code still read `options.retries`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check threw on anything that wasn't exactly `true`/`false`. Added handling to treat `undefined` as `false` (backoff disabled by default).
